critical_boundaries.construction: The positive atlas and root-model rejection are conditional on the explicitly declared W0 commuting/homogeneous triaxial translation construction; first-shell controls alone do not fix shell>=2 cell coordinates if this construction is withheld.
critical_boundaries.coordinates: Only integer triples are stored cell coordinates. Radicals are precollapse algebraic values only.
critical_boundaries.five_control: Not adjudicated because square root is rejected before n=5; neither 5->4 nor 5->9 is promoted.
critical_boundaries.p1: p=1 is the unique survivor only within p=1..6 and radius3; it is the identity count relation, not a nontrivial root-collapse law.
critical_boundaries.square_root: Rejected within the W0 atlas at radius3: at n=3 neither legal adjacent integer root completion 1 nor 2 regenerates C[3,0,0]=(3,-3,-3).
critical_boundaries.universality: No universal BRC law and no theorem about alternative non-translation cell-coordinate ontologies is established.
